laneK4a: Owned kernel handles share the width-aware scheduler registry. DuplicateHandle and same-process OpenProcess/OpenThread produce real handles; GetThreadContext/SetThreadContext and external process creation remain explicitly failure-only. Census capabilities come from FAPI/TF declarations, not DLL presence.
laneK1: /* LANE-K1 */ Offline Windows system DLL contracts; not a host networking bridge.
laneGL: /* LANE-GL */ OpenGL 3.3 bounded profile and WGL.
laneE: /* LANE-E */ Additive COM/property/XInput system DLL names.
comment: System DLLs the Win32 profile implements (by name, case-insensitive). LoadLibrary resolves a name to a shipped pipeline module first (game.json), then to this list; anything else fails with ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND. A static import of a DLL that is in neither fails the build. Entries ending in '*' are prefixes (API sets).
